newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-IVANISEVIC FIGHTS BACK TO MAKE QUARTER-FINALS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-IVANISEVIC FIGHTS BACK TO MAKE QUARTER-FINALS.

text.p: Third seed Goran Ivanisevic of Croatia staged a brave fight-back to beat unseeded Norwegian Christian Ruud in a marathon five-set duel in the fourth round of the Australian Open on Monday.
Ivanisevic trailed two sets to one, before staging a memorable comeback in oppressive conditions to win 4-6 6-2 6-7 6-3 6-3 in three hours and four minutes.
The big-hitting Croat hammered 38 aces to Ruud's 13 on an outside court which offered little shelter from the blazing sun.
Ivanisevic was not in full control of his first serve, landing less than half of them. He double-faulted 16 times.
The world number four will meet either fifth seed Thomas Muster of Austria or American 11th seed Jim Courier in the quarter-finals.
